title: Literature review task
description: One bounded research question. Each run answers one question; a follow-up question is a new run.

question.title: Research question
question.description: The question the review should answer, in one or two sentences.
examples: What defenses have been proposed against prompt injection attacks on LLM-integrated applications?

seeds.title: Seed papers
seeds.description: Optional titles, DOIs or arXiv ids to look up first. Seeds are search hints, not verified references.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Optional PDFs selected on this host, keyed by the DOI of the paper each one is. The package receives only opaque document ids, never a path.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: live for real research; fixture marks the result as a synthetic demonstration.

use_profile.title: Use my research profile
use_profile.description: Read the research profile you choose from your memory (interests, topics to avoid) to shape the search.

keep_notes.title: Keep agent notes
keep_notes.description: Let this agent read its own short notes from earlier runs and keep new ones, which you can read and clear in Settings.

reviewed_on.title: Review date
reviewed_on.description: Today's date (YYYY-MM-DD). Given, the run proposes to remember this review; you accept, edit or reject it after the run.
